headerDisplay: Receives events from an Ajax hub over SIA DC-09 and exposes them to HomeKit. In the Ajax app, point **Monitoring station** at this Homebridge server (see the README).

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the alarm in the Home app.

accountId.title: Object number
accountId.description: The "Object number" configured in the hub's Monitoring station settings: 3 to 16 hexadecimal characters.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port the plugin listens on. Enter the same one on the hub.

encryptionKey.title: Encryption key
encryptionKey.description: Optional. Same key as set on the hub. 16, 24 or 32 characters. When set, unencrypted messages are refused.

devices.title: Detectors
devices.description: Detectors to expose as HomeKit sensors. Trigger a detector once and the Homebridge log tells you its zone number.

areas.title: Groups
areas.description: Number of Ajax groups. With more than one, the alarm shows "Home" until every group is armed.

motionResetSeconds.title: Motion reset (seconds)
motionResetSeconds.description: Ajax reports a motion once. HomeKit shows it for this long.

heartbeatTimeoutMinutes.title: Hub silence timeout (minutes)
heartbeatTimeoutMinutes.description: Report a fault when the hub sends nothing for this long. Needs "Periodic test" enabled on the hub, with a shorter interval. 0 disables.

maxTimeSkewSeconds.title: Allowed clock difference (seconds)
maxTimeSkewSeconds.description: Messages carrying a timestamp further from this server's clock are refused. 0 disables the check.

allowedAddresses.title: Allowed hub addresses
allowedAddresses.description: Optional. Only accept traffic from these IP addresses.
